description: Grid-based cavity volume comparison at the PLP site, rat Accsl model vs apple ACC synthase 1B8G, plus domain architecture of the Accsl model from pLDDT and alignment coverage
code:
import requests, numpy as np, re
from scipy.spatial import cKDTree
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- 1. fetch structures ----------
UA={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'}
af = requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-D3ZUW2-F1-model_v6.pdb', headers=UA, timeout=60).text
b8g = requests.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/1B8G.pdb', headers=UA, timeout=60).text
print('AF lines', len(af.split('\n')), '1B8G lines', len(b8g.split('\n')))

AA3={'ALA':'A','ARG':'R','ASN':'N','ASP':'D','CYS':'C','GLN':'Q','GLU':'E','GLY':'G','HIS':'H',
     'ILE':'I','LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','MSE':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T',
     'TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}

def parse(txt):
    ch={}; het=[]
    for L in txt.split('\n'):
        rec=L[:6]
        if rec not in ('ATOM  ','HETATM'): continue
        alt=L[16]
        if alt not in (' ','A'): continue
        rn=L[17:20].strip(); name=L[12:16].strip(); c=L[21]
        try: num=int(L[22:26])
        except: continue
        xyz=np.array([float(L[30:38]),float(L[38:46]),float(L[46:54])])
        b=float(L[60:66]) if L[60:66].strip() else 0.0
        if rec=='HETATM' and rn not in AA3:
            if rn=='HOH': continue
            het.append((rn,c,num,name,xyz)); continue
        if rn not in AA3: continue
        ch.setdefault(c,{}).setdefault((c,num),{'aa':AA3[rn],'atoms':{},'b':b})
        ch[c][(c,num)]['atoms'][name]=xyz
        if name=='CA': ch[c][(c,num)]['b']=b
    return ch,het

A,_   = parse(af)
B,HET = parse(b8g)
accsl = A['A']; apA = B['A']; apB = B['B']
plpA = np.array([x for (rn,c,n,nm,x) in HET if rn=='PLP' and c=='A'])
print('Accsl res', len(accsl), 'apple A', len(apA), 'apple B', len(apB), 'PLP atoms A', len(plpA))

def seqof(d):
    ks=sorted(d, key=lambda k:k[1])
    return ''.join(d[k]['aa'] for k in ks), ks

# ---------- 2. BLOSUM62 + vectorised affine NW ----------
B62="""A R N D C Q E G H I L K M F P S T W Y V
A 4 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -1 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 0 -3 -2 0
R -1 5 0 -2 -3 1 0 -2 0 -3 -2 2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
N -2 0 6 1 -3 0 0 0 1 -3 -3 0 -2 -3 -2 1 0 -4 -2 -3
D -2 -2 1 6 -3 0 2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1 0 -1 -4 -3 -3
C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
rows=B62.strip().split('\n'); AAo=rows[0].split()
MAT=np.array([[int(v) for v in r.split()[1:]] for r in rows[1:]],float)
IDX={a:i for i,a in enumerate(AAo)}
enc=lambda s: np.array([IDX.get(c,IDX['A']) for c in s])
NEG=-1e9
def nw(s1,s2,go=-11.,ge=-1.):
    e1,e2=enc(s1),enc(s2); n,m=len(s1),len(s2)
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);M[0,0]=0.
    Ix[1:,0]=go+ge*np.arange(n);Iy[0,1:]=go+ge*np.arange(m);jj=np.arange(m+1)
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        s=MAT[e1[i-1],e2]
        M[i,1:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:m],Ix[i-1,:m]),Iy[i-1,:m])+s
        Ix[i,:]=np.maximum(np.maximum(M[i-1,:]+go,Ix[i-1,:]+ge),Iy[i-1,:]+go)
        G=np.maximum.accumulate(np.maximum(M[i,:]+go,Ix[i,:]+go)-ge*jj)
        Iy[i,1:]=ge*(jj[1:]-1)+G[:m]
    i,j=n,m; st='M' if M[n,m]>=max(Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]) else ('Ix' if Ix[n,m]>=Iy[n,m] else 'Iy')
    pairs=[]
    while i>0 or j>0:
        if i==0: st='Iy'
        elif j==0: st='Ix'
        if st=='M':
            pairs.append((i-1,j-1)); sc=M[i,j]-MAT[e1[i-1],e2[j-1]]
            st='M' if abs(sc-M[i-1,j-1])<1e-6 else ('Ix' if abs(sc-Ix[i-1,j-1])<1e-6 else 'Iy')
            i-=1;j-=1
        elif st=='Ix':
            v=Ix[i,j]
            st='Ix' if abs(v-(Ix[i-1,j]+ge))<1e-6 else ('M' if abs(v-(M[i-1,j]+go))<1e-6 else 'Iy')
            i-=1
        else:
            v=Iy[i,j]
            st='Iy' if abs(v-(Iy[i,j-1]+ge))<1e-6 else ('M' if abs(v-(M[i,j-1]+go))<1e-6 else 'Ix')
            j-=1
    return pairs[::-1]

sA,kA=seqof(accsl); sP,kP=seqof(apA)
pairs=nw(sA,sP)
ident=sum(1 for i,j in pairs if sA[i]==sP[j])
print(f'aligned columns {len(pairs)}  identities {ident} = {100*ident/len(pairs):.1f}%')

# ---------- 3. Kabsch superposition (Accsl -> apple frame) ----------
def kab(P,Q):
    pc=P.mean(0);qc=Q.mean(0);H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc);U,S,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T))])@U.T
    return R, qc-R@pc
def fit(P,Q,rounds=8):
    keep=np.ones(len(P),bool)
    for _ in range(rounds):
        R,t=kab(P[keep],Q[keep]); d=np.linalg.norm((P@R.T+t)-Q,axis=1)
        keep=d<max(3.0,np.percentile(d,80))
    R,t=kab(P[keep],Q[keep]); d=np.linalg.norm((P@R.T+t)-Q,axis=1)
    return R,t,keep,np.sqrt((d[keep]**2).mean())

co=[(i,j) for i,j in pairs if 'CA' in accsl[kA[i]]['atoms'] and 'CA' in apA[kP[j]]['atoms']]
P=np.array([accsl[kA[i]]['atoms']['CA'] for i,j in co]); Q=np.array([apA[kP[j]]['atoms']['CA'] for i,j in co])
R,t,keep,rms=fit(P,Q); print(f'core CA RMSD {rms:.2f} A over {keep.sum()} residues')

# apple chain A -> chain B operator (from equivalent CA pairs present in both)
common=[k[1] for k in apA if ('B',k[1]) in apB and 'CA' in apA[k]['atoms'] and 'CA' in apB[('B',k[1])]['atoms']]
PA=np.array([apA[('A',n)]['atoms']['CA'] for n in common]); PB=np.array([apB[('B',n)]['atoms']['CA'] for n in common])
R2,t2=kab(PA,PB)

def coords(d, Rm=None, tv=None):
    xs=[];lab=[]
    for k in sorted(d,key=lambda k:k[1]):
        for nm,x in d[k]['atoms'].items():
            if nm.startswith('H'): continue
            xs.append(x); lab.append((k[1],d[k]['aa'],nm))
    X=np.array(xs)
    if Rm is not None: X=X@Rm.T+tv
    return X,lab

ac1,lab1=coords(accsl,R,t)                       # Accsl in apple frame
ac2,lab2=coords(accsl,R,t); ac2=ac2@R2.T+t2      # pseudo-dimer partner
apAx,labA=coords(apA); apBx,labB=coords(apB)

# ---------- 4. grid cavity volume at the PLP site ----------
cen=plpA.mean(0); step=0.6; half=13.0
g=np.arange(-half,half+1e-9,step)
G=np.stack(np.meshgrid(g,g,g,indexing='ij'),-1).reshape(-1,3)+cen
G=G[np.linalg.norm(G-cen,axis=1)<=half]
dirs=[]
for a in (-1,0,1):
    for b in (-1,0,1):
        for c in (-1,0,1):
            if a or b or c: dirs.append([a,b,c])
dirs=np.array(dirs,float); dirs/=np.linalg.norm(dirs,axis=1)[:,None]
steps=np.arange(2.0,14.1,1.0)

def cavity(X, label):
    T=cKDTree(X)
    d,_=T.query(G)
    cand=G[(d>3.2)&(d<9.0)]
    if len(cand)==0: return 0.0,[],None
    pts=(cand[:,None,None,:]+dirs[None,:,None,:]*steps[None,None,:,None]).reshape(-1,3)
    hit=T.query(pts)[0].reshape(len(cand),len(dirs),len(steps))<2.4
    bur=hit.any(2).mean(1)
    cav=cand[bur>=0.85]
    if len(cav)==0: return 0.0,[],None
    # flood fill from the grid point closest to the PLP centroid
    Tc=cKDTree(cav); seed=int(np.argmin(np.linalg.norm(cav-cen,axis=1)))
    seen={seed}; stack=[seed]
    while stack:
        i=stack.pop()
        for j in Tc.query_ball_point(cav[i], step*1.45):
            if j not in seen: seen.add(j); stack.append(j)
    sel=cav[sorted(seen)]
    vol=len(sel)*step**3
    # lining residues
    dd,ii=cKDTree(X).query(sel)
    lin=sorted({label[k][:2] for k in ii})
    return vol,lin,sel

protA=np.vstack([apAx]); protAB=np.vstack([apAx,apBx])
labAB=labA+labB
volA,linA,selA=cavity(protA,labA)
volAB,linAB,_  =cavity(protAB,labAB)
volC,linC,selC=cavity(ac1,lab1)
volCD,linCD,_  =cavity(np.vstack([ac1,ac2]),lab1+lab2)
print(f'\ncavity volume (A^3), probe-accessible buried, connected to PLP centroid')
print(f'  apple ACS monomer (chain A)     {volA:8.1f}   lining residues {len(linA)}')
print(f'  apple ACS dimer   (A+B)         {volAB:8.1f}   lining residues {len(linAB)}')
print(f'  rat Accsl monomer               {volC:8.1f}   lining residues {len(linC)}')
print(f'  rat Accsl pseudo-dimer          {volCD:8.1f}   lining residues {len(linCD)}')
print(f'  dimer ratio Accsl/ACS           {volCD/volAB:8.2f}')

# ---------- 5. domain architecture of the Accsl model ----------
plddt=np.array([accsl[k]['b'] for k in kA]); nums=np.array([k[1] for k in kA])
amap={i for i,j in pairs}
aligned=np.array([i in amap for i in range(len(sA))])
# contiguous unaligned blocks >= 8 residues
blocks=[];s=None
for i in range(len(sA)+1):
    a = aligned[i] if i<len(sA) else True
    if not a and s is None: s=i
    if a and s is not None:
        if i-s>=8: blocks.append((nums[s],nums[i-1],i-s,plddt[s:i].mean()))
        s=None
print('\nAccsl segments with no ACS counterpart (>=8 res): start end length meanPLDDT')
for b_ in blocks: print(f'  {b_[0]:4d} {b_[1]:4d} {b_[2]:4d}  {b_[3]:6.1f}')
print(f'\nmean pLDDT whole chain {plddt.mean():.1f}; aligned-core {plddt[aligned].mean():.1f}; outside core {plddt[~aligned].mean():.1f}')
print(f'residues with pLDDT<70: {(plddt<70).sum()} of {len(plddt)}')

pae=requests.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-D3ZUW2-F1-predicted_aligned_error_v6.json',headers=UA,timeout=60).json()
PAE=np.array(pae[0]['predicted_aligned_error'],float)
core=np.where(aligned)[0]
for b_ in blocks:
    sl=np.where((nums>=b_[0])&(nums<=b_[1]))[0]
    print(f'  block {b_[0]}-{b_[1]}: mean PAE to aligned core {PAE[np.ix_(sl,core)].mean():5.1f} A')

# ---------- 6. figure ----------
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(13,4.6))
names=['ACS\nmonomer','ACS\ndimer','Accsl\nmonomer','Accsl\npseudo-dimer']
vals=[volA,volAB,volC,volCD]
cols=['#4c72b0','#4c72b0','#c44e52','#c44e52']
bars=ax[0].bar(names,vals,color=cols)
for b_,v in zip(bars,vals): ax[0].text(b_.get_x()+b_.get_width()/2,v+8,f'{v:.0f}',ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax[0].set_ylabel('buried cavity volume at the PLP site (A$^3$)')
ax[0].set_title('a) The Accsl active-site cavity is smaller than\nthe ACC synthase cavity',fontsize=10,loc='left')
ax[1].plot(nums,plddt,lw=0.9,color='0.4')
ax[1].fill_between(nums,0,100,where=aligned,color='#4c72b0',alpha=0.18,step='mid',label='aligns to apple ACS')
for b_ in blocks: ax[1].axvspan(b_[0],b_[1],color='#c44e52',alpha=0.18)
ax[1].axhline(70,ls='--',lw=0.8,color='k')
for p,lb in [(419,'K419'),(382,'D382'),(229,'S229'),(447,'Y447'),(553,'R553')]:
    ax[1].plot(p,plddt[nums==p][0],'o',ms=5,color='k'); ax[1].annotate(lb,(p,plddt[nums==p][0]),textcoords='offset points',xytext=(0,-14),ha='center',fontsize=8)
ax[1].set_xlabel('rat Accsl residue'); ax[1].set_ylabel('pLDDT'); ax[1].set_ylim(0,105)
ax[1].legend(fontsize=8,loc='lower right')
ax[1].set_title('b) Model confidence and ACS-aligned core\n(red bands: segments with no ACS counterpart)',fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

import pandas as pd
pd.DataFrame({'structure':['ACS_monomer','ACS_dimer','Accsl_monomer','Accsl_pseudodimer'],
              'cavity_volume_A3':[round(v,1) for v in vals],
              'n_lining_residues':[len(linA),len(linAB),len(linC),len(linCD)]}).to_csv('/tmp/cav.csv',index=False)
print('\nAccsl cavity lining residues:', [f'{a}{n}' for n,a in linC])
print('\nACS cavity lining residues  :', [f'{a}{n}' for n,a in linA])
